memories.content: I applied to REDACTED-CDN-CORP today for a Senior SWE role at ~$185k. Source: company referral via REDACTED-CONTACT-1. URL: https://redacted-cdn.example/careers/ssr-12345
REDACTED-CONTACT-2 is a recruiter at REDACTED-FINTECH-CORP. Met at a meetup. Reaches out about backend roles ~quarterly. Prefers email over LinkedIn.

REDACTED-EDGE-CORP — small (~80 person) edge-compute company headquartered in Berlin. Series B (2024). Known for solid engineering culture and a flexible-remote stance. Roles tend to require strong distributed-systems background.
Engram v0.1 MCP foundation — owner: russellkmoore@mac.com — deadline: 2026-06-07 — currently in Phase 5 (AI integration). Status: on track; eval gate is the main risk.

Decided to keep Workers AI + Vectorize in Engram v0.1 rather than deferring AI to v0.2. Rationale: the user-facing acceptance test (remember a job posting then recall from a different conversation) is meaningless without semantic recall. Researcher recommendation was overridden.
REDACTED-CONTACT-3 is the EM at REDACTED-PAYMENTS-CORP. Met for coffee in March.
REDACTED-CONTACT-4 is the staff SWE at REDACTED-PAYMENTS-CORP focused on the ledger team. Spoke briefly at a conference.
Applied to REDACTED-FINTECH-CORP in January 2026 for a backend SWE role. Status: rejected at phone screen.
Decided in March to standardize on TypeScript strict mode for all new Engram packages. Rationale: avoid the v0 typing-debt accumulation seen in earlier projects.
REDACTED-APPLE-CORP is the developer-tooling subsidiary of a large consumer-electronics conglomerate. Roles tend to be tools-platform and internal-developer-experience.

Applied to REDACTED-AI-INFRA-CORP for the Tech Lead, ML Platform role on 2026-05-12. Salary band: $220k–$260k base + ~0.3% equity. Source: cold outreach via LinkedIn. Hiring manager: REDACTED-CONTACT-5.
REDACTED-CONTACT-6 — VP Engineering at REDACTED-DEVTOOLS-CORP. Met at a Cloudflare dev day in Q4 2025. Active reference. Reachable at redacted@example.com.
REDACTED-OBSV-CORP is a mid-size (~400 person) observability company; Series D 2025; remote-first. Recent product push into AI-pipeline tracing — strong hiring signal there.
Side project: building a CLI for archiving Linear issues into local SQLite for offline search. Owner: russellkmoore@mac.com. Target ship: end of June 2026. Status: prototype.
Engram v0.1 will NOT include a human web UI — MCP tool surface is the product. Web UI is v1.0+ work after the hosted offering exists. Decided 2026-04-15.

Research note on Vectorize internals: metadata index uses sparse inverted index over the metadata column. Filter cardinality of <1% slows query latency 2-3x. Cosine metric default. Max 4 metadata indexes.
Lecture notes on CAP theorem: partition tolerance is not optional for distributed systems — always P, choose between C and A. DO-per-workspace gives strong consistency within a workspace boundary.
Vectorize metadata filter cardinality study: sparse inverted index; <1% cardinality forces post-filter (2-3x slower). Binary scope metadata is safe. Do not add memory_type metadata index until v0.2.
Applied to a remote Senior Director, Solution Architecture role at REDACTED-DEVOPS-PLATFORM. Base $244,200-$409,500 plus up to 100% incentive pay. Leads SA managers across North America.

Applied to Distinguished Engineer, Agentic SDLC & Non-Linear Productivity at REDACTED-DEVOPS-PLATFORM. Base $260,000-$345,000. Remote US/Canada. Pioneers autonomous AI-agent capabilities across the SDLC.

Applied to Head of Product, Trust & Safety at REDACTED-FINTECH-PAYMENTS. $304,500-$456,700 USD. Remote or Bay Area. Unifies risk + identity orgs across Square to protect sellers from fraud while enabling growth.

Applied to Sr. Director, Platform Engineering at REDACTED-RETAIL-CORP today. Base $223,400-$301,600. Pleasanton CA, on-site. Leads cloud platform strategy + CD infrastructure + DevOps across Azure and GCP.
Applied to Engineering Manager, Data Orchestration Platform at REDACTED-PAYMENTS-PLATFORM. Base $236,000-$354,000. Seattle or remote 35+ miles. Owns the Airflow workflow scheduling platform.

Applied to Global Payments Experiences Engineering Manager at REDACTED-PAYMENTS-PLATFORM. Base $236,000-$354,000. Seattle office (50% in-office minimum). Builds payment solutions for global merchants.

Applied to Engineering Manager, User Compliance at REDACTED-PAYMENTS-PLATFORM. Base $214,600-$321,800. Remote US. Builds systems for customer data verification + risk management across the compliance platform.
Applied to Engineering Manager, Mobile AI at REDACTED-DOCS-PLATFORM. Leads engineering for mobile AI initiatives.
Applied to Engineering Manager I, Threat Detection at REDACTED-OBSERVABILITY-VENDOR. Base $192,000-$240,000. New York hybrid. Leads team building detection systems + AI-accelerated threat response.

Applied to Distinguished Architect, AI at REDACTED-OBSERVABILITY-VENDOR. Base $300,000-$484,000. New York or San Francisco, hybrid, up to 50% travel. Technical multiplier for AI labs and AI-native companies.
Applied to Principal Software Engineer at REDACTED-COMMS-API. Comp tiered by location: $188,240-$235,300 base. Remote US. Customer-facing technical expert delivering code + demos.

Applied to Director, Custom Product & Operations at REDACTED-APPAREL-WHOLESALER. Base $160,000-$235,000 + bonus. Issaquah WA hybrid. Manages custom product portfolio + ops team + strategic customer relationships.
Applied to Director, Product - Enterprise at REDACTED-DESIGN-TOOLS-CORP. Base $290,000-$376,000 USD. SF or NY. Drives product strategy for AI enterprise-focused product areas.
LinkedIn keyword-search lead: VP, Digital at REDACTED-OUTDOOR-RETAIL-COOP. Just spotted; need to look up the actual posting before deciding to apply. Outdoor retail co-op brand.

Spotted on LinkedIn: Director, Engineering, NG-SIEM Serverless Platform at REDACTED-SECURITY-VENDOR. Hybrid arrangement. Worth a closer look — strong security infra play with serverless platform angle.
Spotted on LinkedIn: Director, Engineering — Listings and Evaluation at REDACTED-REAL-ESTATE-PLATFORM. Real estate domain; mid-funnel data + ML for property valuation. Haven't applied yet.
Spotted on LinkedIn: VP, Reasoning Systems at REDACTED-ENTERPRISE-AI-PLATFORM. Title is intriguing — sounds like LLM agent / reasoning stack. Haven't applied yet.
LinkedIn lead: VP Engineering at REDACTED-LIFE-SCIENCES-SAAS. Need to investigate — strong reputation but smaller engineering footprint than the larger platforms I've been looking at.
LinkedIn lead: Head of Business Technology Program Management at REDACTED-LEGAL-AI-STARTUP. Worth understanding what 'BizTech program mgmt' actually means at an AI-first legal startup.

Decision (Phase 6 D-01, 2026-05-26): defer per-write conflict detection entirely from v0.1 of Engram. Rationale: PIP-04 amended to drop the conflict detection clause; ENG-16 will validate precision empirically before v0.2.

Decision (2026-05-31 via ENG-21): switched the Triage Worker JSON-schema converter from zod-to-json-schema@3 to Zod v4's native z.toJSONSchema(). The third-party converter silently returned {} on zod@4 schemas.

Spike SEED-001 finding: bge-base-en-v1.5 embedding sensibility test on Engram corpus. Delta=0.0696 between domain-clustering and memory-type-clustering. BORDERLINE — embedding captures domain more strongly than memory-type.

Research note: the Cloudflare agents SDK getAgentByName(namespace, name) returns a Promise<DurableObjectStub<T>> that MUST be awaited. Missing the await yields a Promise where the user expected a stub.
Project: cf-code-assist routing tracker (Phase 4). Status: closed 2026-05-27 after /gsd:verify-work 4 passed. Documented 0/16 tasks routed in honest end-of-phase post-mortem.

Contact: Karri Saarinen — co-founder and CEO at REDACTED-ISSUE-TRACKER. Met at QCon Plus 2025. Worth keeping in the loop as Engram itself shapes up — possible reciprocal interest in MCP-native tooling.

Meeting (2026-05-28): Phase 7 planning session. Attendees: russellkmoore + Claude. Decisions: ship MCP server first, defer v0.4 connector framework. Action items: confirm OAuth flow, finalize KV bootstrap, wire Cloudflare Workers Builds.

Decision (AI-04, Phase 5 AI-SPEC.md §4): HYBRID_WEIGHTS frozen at cosine: 1.0, recency: 0.15, type_match: 0.2, scope_match: 0.15. 30-day recency half-life. Locked until empirical eval data justifies weight tuning.
Senior Director of Engineering role at REDACTED-CLOUD-SERVICES. Base $280,000-$370,000. Remote first with quarterly gatherings. Leads distributed platform team of 40+ across 3 sub-teams.
VP of Product at REDACTED-DEVELOPER-TOOLS. Series C startup with $120M ARR. Fully remote. Owns the product roadmap for the developer platform targeting Fortune 500 clients.
CTO conversation with REDACTED-CONTACT-7 at REDACTED-AI-STARTUP. Met at NeurIPS 2025. Building LLM routing infrastructure. Interested in advisory relationship.
REDACTED-INFRA-VENDOR is the infrastructure platform company building next-gen deployment tools. Series D 2025, ~600 employees. Strong in Kubernetes and serverless orchestration.
Personal project: building a TypeScript-first CLI framework for developer tools. Goal: reduce boilerplate for command registration. Status: early prototype, 3 months in.
Decision: standardize on Bun for all new internal tooling scripts. Rationale: faster startup than Node.js, compatible with existing TypeScript, native test runner avoids vitest dependency.
Research: Cloudflare D1 vs Durable Objects SQLite for team workspaces. D1 lacks per-tenant isolation. DO-per-workspace is the right pattern for Engram's multi-tenant architecture.
Meeting notes from REDACTED-COMPANY-A quarterly planning. Q3 priorities: AI tooling integration, developer experience improvements, and new enterprise tier launch.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-8, Head of Platform Engineering at REDACTED-FINTECH-B. Referred by REDACTED-CONTACT-1. Strong background in payment infrastructure. Available for coffee next month.
Applied to Director of Engineering at REDACTED-MEDIA-CORP. Base $230,000-$295,000. Los Angeles hybrid. Leads the streaming infrastructure and real-time data platform teams.
Research: WebAssembly for edge-native data processing. Cloudflare Workers with WASM modules can process structured data 10x faster than JSON parsing alone. Relevant for Engram triage pipeline.
REDACTED-SAAS-CORP is a SaaS platform serving mid-market HR teams. Series B, 200 employees. Offices in Austin TX and Toronto. Recent AI features for workforce analytics.
Decision: use OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing across all Engram Workers. Rationale: vendor-neutral, Cloudflare Workers supports OTLP export natively.
Applied to Engineering Manager, Platform at REDACTED-FINTECH-C. Base $195,000-$255,000. New York or San Francisco. Leads the core platform team responsible for payment routing.

Research: vector database comparison for semantic search. Pinecone vs Weaviate vs Cloudflare Vectorize. Vectorize wins on latency and Cloudflare-native integration; Pinecone has more mature filtering.
Personal project: OAuth proxy server for developer tooling integrations. TypeScript + Hono framework. Status: MVP complete, pending security review.
Research: LLM context window management strategies. RAG vs long-context. For Engram: hybrid approach — short context with RAG for high-volume queries, long context for synthesis.
Applied to VP Engineering at REDACTED-MARKETPLACE-CORP. Base $320,000-$420,000. San Francisco hybrid. Leads 120-person engineering org across marketplace, payments, and trust & safety.
REDACTED-AI-CO is an AI-native startup building code generation tools. 50 employees, Series A 2025. Fully remote. Strong engineering team from major tech companies.
Decision: adopt Conventional Commits standard for all Engram development. Enables automated changelog generation and semantic versioning.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-9, Principal Engineer at REDACTED-CLOUD-PROVIDER. Met at KubeCon 2025. Expert in distributed systems and consensus protocols. Possible engineering advisor.
Meeting notes from engineering all-hands Q2. Main themes: AI integration strategy, developer productivity improvements, and transition to platform-as-a-product model.
Applied to Staff Engineer, Infrastructure at REDACTED-AI-PLATFORM. Base $280,000-$360,000. Fully remote. Builds the compute infrastructure powering large-scale model training and inference.
Research: Cloudflare Workers AI inference latency benchmarks. qwen3-embedding-0.6b: ~45ms p50, ~120ms p99 for 512-token inputs. Acceptable for Engram's async ingest pipeline.
REDACTED-DEVPLATFORM-CORP builds internal developer platforms. 300 employees, Series C. Remote-first. Product: developer portals, service catalogs, and deployment automation.
Personal project: Engram CLI for local development and testing. Status: design phase. Will wrap the MCP tool surface for terminal-based workflows.
Decision: use Zod v4 as the primary schema validation library across all Engram packages. Rationale: native JSON Schema export, smaller bundle, better TypeScript inference.
Applied to Director, AI Platform at REDACTED-ENTERPRISE-SAAS. Base $260,000-$340,000. Chicago or remote. Leads the AI platform team responsible for LLM integration across the product suite.
Research: TypeScript decorators for schema-driven memory types. Decorator-based approach vs schema-as-data. Decision: schema-as-data wins for runtime extensibility; decorators require redeployment.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-10, Head of Engineering at REDACTED-HEALTHCARE-TECH. Referred through LinkedIn. Background in health data infrastructure and HIPAA-compliant systems.
Applied to VP of Engineering at REDACTED-EDTECH-CORP. Base $240,000-$310,000. New York City hybrid 3 days/week. Leads 80-person engineering team focused on adaptive learning platform.
REDACTED-PLATFORM-CO is a B2B SaaS platform for logistics management. Series D 2025, 500 employees. Offices in Seattle and Amsterdam. Strong in real-time shipment tracking.
Research: MCP protocol architecture and tool surface design. Key insight: tool count must stay minimal — cognitive overhead for AI clients scales with tool count. Engram target: ≤9 tools.
Meeting notes from career coaching session. Key themes: targeting VP/Director+ roles, emphasizing platform engineering background, improving narrative around AI product leadership.
Applied to Senior Director of Product at REDACTED-FINTECH-D. Base $275,000-$350,000. SF Bay Area hybrid. Leads product strategy for the core financial services platform.
Decision: Engram v0.2 will use progressive enrichment — Phase 1 immediate sync, Phase 2 async background, Phase 3 scheduled batch. This prevents Claude from waiting on full AI pipeline.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-11, VP Product at REDACTED-API-PLATFORM. Former colleague from REDACTED-PREV-COMPANY. Open to discussing Engram as potential customer use case.
Applied to Engineering Director, Data Platform at REDACTED-RETAIL-TECH. Base $250,000-$325,000. Remote US. Leads the data engineering organization responsible for analytics and ML infrastructure.
Research: Cloudflare Queue delivery semantics. At-least-once delivery requires idempotent consumers. Engram triage worker must check block_id existence before inserting to avoid duplicates.
REDACTED-GAMING-CORP is a mobile gaming company with 200M+ users. Series E 2024. San Francisco HQ, remote engineering. Strong in real-time multiplayer infrastructure.
Research: embedding model comparison for semantic memory retrieval. qwen3-embedding-0.6b (1024d) vs bge-base-en-v1.5 (768d). qwen3 wins on domain clustering for technical content.
Applied to CTO at REDACTED-EARLY-STAGE-STARTUP. Equity-heavy comp, base $200,000-$280,000. San Francisco. Building developer infrastructure tools with AI-first design. 15 employees.
Decision: Engram's conflict detection will use embedding similarity threshold 0.85 as the trigger for potential conflict review. Lower threshold generates too many false positives.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-12, Founder at REDACTED-AI-INFRA-STARTUP. Met at a Cloudflare event. Building on similar infrastructure. Possible collaboration on MCP tooling standards.
Meeting notes from 1:1 with executive coach. Focus areas: communicating technical vision to non-technical boards, building high-performing distributed teams, navigating organizational ambiguity.
Applied to VP Engineering at REDACTED-HR-TECH. Base $295,000-$385,000. Fully remote. Leads platform engineering for workforce management SaaS serving 50,000+ businesses.

Research: Durable Objects hibernation API performance characteristics. Objects that have been inactive for >1s are hibernated. Cold start penalty: ~5ms. Warm hit: ~0.5ms. Acceptable for Engram's workspace pattern.
REDACTED-DEVTOOLS-B is a developer tools company building code review and PR automation. Series B 2025, 80 employees. Fully remote. Strong in ML-powered code analysis.
Applied to Director, Platform Engineering at REDACTED-FINTECH-E. Base $240,000-$315,000. Chicago or New York. Owns the core payment processing infrastructure and developer APIs.
Decision: Engram's MCP server will use stateless JWT validation — no session store, no KV lookups per request. Workspace ID extracted from JWT claims and passed to DO via service binding.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-13, Director of Engineering at REDACTED-FINTECH-F. Recruiter introduced us. Background in distributed payments systems. Coffee scheduled for next week.
Research: Cloudflare Workers memory limits. Each Worker isolate has 128MB memory limit. Engram's JSON processing of large memory exports needs chunking to stay within this limit.
Applied to Staff Engineer, ML Infrastructure at REDACTED-AI-RESEARCH-LAB. Base $310,000-$420,000. Fully remote. Builds the training infrastructure for frontier AI models.
Research: semantic chunking strategies for long-form content. Sentence-boundary aware chunking with 50-token overlap performs best for recall on Engram's use case. Target: 512-token max chunks.
REDACTED-PROTOCOL-CORP is a web3 infrastructure company building developer tooling for EVM chains. Series C 2025, 120 employees. Offices in NYC and London.
Decision: Engram v0.3 will introduce Project DOs — fully isolated from TeamDO, enabling clean archive and delete semantics per project. Not a partition of TeamDO.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-14, Head of AI at REDACTED-ENTERPRISE-B. Met through a mutual connection. Interested in Engram as internal knowledge management tool for their AI team.
Applied to Director of Engineering at REDACTED-CYBERSECURITY-CORP. Base $255,000-$330,000. Remote US. Leads security platform engineering team responsible for threat intelligence infrastructure.
Research: R2 storage pricing for Engram exports. $0.015/GB storage, $0.36/million reads, $4.50/million writes. At 1000 users with 100 exports/day at ~1MB each: ~$50/month. Acceptable.
REDACTED-DATA-PLATFORM is a data engineering platform company. Series D 2025, 450 employees. San Francisco HQ with remote engineering. Leader in real-time data pipelines.
Personal project: Engram Slack connector (v0.4 preview). Status: design phase. Will use Slack Events API for streaming channel ingestion. Target: Q3 2026.
Decision: Engram's inbox threshold is 0.4-0.8 memorability score. Below 0.4: cold storage (never discard). Above 0.8: auto-store. This is the cardinal-sin clause — no discards.
Research: MTEB benchmark results for embedding models in 2026. qwen3-embedding-0.6b ranks top-5 on retrieval tasks across multiple languages. Appropriate for Engram's multilingual user base.
Meeting notes from investor update call. Discussed Engram v0.1 launch timeline, MCP adoption trends, and the open-core business model ($5-20/month managed cloud tier).
Applied to CTO / VP Engineering at REDACTED-CLIMATE-TECH. Base $280,000-$380,000. San Francisco. Leads full engineering org for climate monitoring SaaS platform.
Research: conflict detection precision vs recall trade-off. Engram ENG-16 study: 87.5% precision, 93.3% recall on 30-pair test corpus at 0.85 similarity threshold. Ship as inbox suggestions.
REDACTED-API-GATEWAY-CO builds enterprise API gateway and management infrastructure. Series C 2026, 180 employees. Offices in Boston and London. Strong in traffic management and security.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-15, Partner at REDACTED-VC-FIRM. Met at a developer conference. Follow-up on Engram's open-core model and go-to-market strategy for v1.0.
Applied to VP of Technology at REDACTED-AEROSPACE-CORP. Base $300,000-$400,000. Washington DC area. Leads embedded systems and real-time data infrastructure for aerospace applications.
Research: Cloudflare Workers Builds for per-worker CI/CD. Automatic builds triggered on git push. Supports monorepo with per-package wrangler.jsonc. Good fit for Engram's package structure.
Personal project: notebook for architecture decision records (ADR). Using Markdown + git for decision tracking. Considering migrating to Engram once v0.1 ships.
Decision: use Cloudflare KV for workspace membership and configuration storage. Fast reads, global replication. Write through DO for strong consistency on membership changes.
Contact: REDACTED-CONTACT-16, Engineering Manager at REDACTED-CLOUD-B. Met at a TypeScript meetup. Background in developer tooling and CLI frameworks. Possible Engram contributor.
Applied to Principal Product Manager at REDACTED-DEVTOOLS-C. Base $220,000-$290,000. Remote US. Owns the product strategy for developer productivity tooling serving 500K+ developers.
Research: Workers Analytics Engine write throughput. 25 writes/second sustained per account. At Engram scale (1000 users, 100 memories/day): ~1.2 writes/second. Comfortably within limit.
